text: ALOHA ViperX-300 6DOF  Overview  The ALOHA ViperX-300 6DOF Robot Arm is a variant of the ViperX-300 6DOF with improvements following those proposed in ALOHA 2 . See the ViperX-300 6DOF specifications page for more details. ALOHA ViperX-300 6DOF Degrees of Freedom 6 Reach 750mm Total Span 1500mm Repeatability 1mm Accuracy 5 - 8mm Working Payload 750g* Total Servos 9 Wrist Rotate Yes Note * Working Payload for the ALOHA ViperX-300 6DOF is inside its maximum reach. If intending to use a 750g weight we recommend no more than a 50% extension of the arm. Default Joint Limits  Default joint limits are the safe range of operation for each joint. These are set in the firmware, defined as degrees from Zero (servo centered).
